raw_posts.name: Jev
raw_posts.tagline: Fast, structured AI decisions for software automation
raw_posts.description: Jev is TypeSafe AI's System One frontier model: unstructured state in, typed probabilistic decisions out. Instead of generating text, Jev returns Choice, Score, and Noul answers with calibrated probabilities your code can act on. Parallel sampling delivers ~70-500ms responses, about 20-200x faster and 40-400x cheaper than comparable LLM workflows, with output tokens free. Now available to everyone at console.typesafe.ai with no waitlist.

raw_posts.name: Superset Mobile
raw_posts.tagline: Your coding agents, now in your pocket
raw_posts.description: Orchestrate coding agents from your iPhone. Pick up the same workspaces from your computer, review diffs, and merge PRs away from your desk. Works with Claude Code, Codex, and other terminal agents. Included with Superset Pro. First month free with code MOBILELAUNCH.

raw_posts.name: Sai
raw_posts.tagline: The autonomous computer fleet at your command
raw_posts.description: Sai is the world's first robosecretary that works with a fleet of autonomous computers, doing your endless screen work. Each computer navigates software the way you do: reads the screen, clicks the button, types in the form. Trained to interact with the computer interface, Sai automates software even when they lack APIs: legacy desktop apps, internal portals, anything behind a login. Sai supports Windows, macOS and Linux. 73% on OSWorld.

raw_posts.name: Arcjet
raw_posts.tagline: Secure the AI agents you're building at runtime
raw_posts.description: Arcjet is the runtime security platform that ships in your AI code. Detect prompt injection, authorize agent tool calls, redact sensitive data, and block bots and abuse. Real-time security building blocks you call inside your app, before an action happens.

raw_posts.name: Hyrax AI
raw_posts.tagline: The AI architect for your entire codebase
raw_posts.description: Code review tools tell you what’s wrong with a PR. Hyrax finds what should improve across your entire codebase and does the work. It builds deep context around your architecture and conventions, prioritizes issues across six engineering domains, writes each fix in context, verifies it against your tests and checks, and opens a GitHub PR for your team to review and merge.

raw_posts.name: Google Flow for iOS & Android
raw_posts.tagline: Google's AI creative studio now on mobile
raw_posts.description: Transform ideas into reality using Google’s advanced generative models for cinematic video, images, & tools, right from your phone. Use direct camera roll and live camera uploads to ground your image and video generations in your own personal experiences. It’s now easier than ever to pull inspiration from your camera roll or photos and videos captured in the moment. And with cross-device project syncing, you take your creative work wherever you go.

raw_posts.name: Sell to State
raw_posts.description: Structured government procurement data around the globe — tenders, suppliers and agencies. We help you research what governments around the world buy and find new opportunities to sell to them. No need to get a foreign company or e-signature before deciding there's money to be made. Browse for free; a flat fee unlocks the full dataset, saved searches, REST API and MCP.

raw_posts.name: CC
raw_posts.tagline: Shared agent that helps keep your family in sync
raw_posts.description: CC is Google Labs’ shared AI agent for families and households. Up to six people can each choose what to share, then CC keeps everyone aligned on the day ahead and takes care of the small logistical work that usually gets lost between inboxes.

raw_posts.name: AI Creative Insights by Decode
raw_posts.tagline: Predict which ad wins before you spend on media
raw_posts.description: Upload any ad, banner, OOH, or video creative and AI Creative Insights predicts how people will respond before your media budget goes live. Get attention heatmaps showing where eyes land first, second-by-second emotion curves, and prescriptive suggestions on what to change and why. Benchmark against category norms, compare variants side by side, and use Synthetic Audience to see predictions persona by persona. Built by Entropik, the team behind Decode.

raw_posts.name: Turfs
raw_posts.tagline: Keep content across your Mac organized in defined areas
raw_posts.description: Use the desktop to keep content from across your Mac accessible and organized in defined areas — or simply keep it clutter-free. A turf can be backed by a real folder, a Finder tag, or your hand-picked selection of files and folders. Turfs stay put through Show Desktop; you choose what Mission Control does with them. Quit, and the desktop is exactly as it was. It replaces Finder's own desktop icon layer, so it can never be sandboxed or sold on the Mac App Store. $29 once, 10-day trial, no card.
